text:
alice: Rolling canary for prompt-edge v3 to 5% in us-west now, will watch latency and error rate
matt: saw a spike in 502/504s from the prompt proxy at 22:14 — p50 latency up ~120ms, p95 up ~700ms
sara: paging oncall, seeing customer errors too? @csm-raj any inbound tickets? :rotating_light:
csm-raj: two customers flagged degraded responses (AcmeCorp, BrightCo). CS opened bridge with Acme, BrightCo notified. Sending logs to the bridge.
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary error rate (prompt-edge-v3) > 4% in us-west for last 2m — triggering alert policy.
matt: logs show upstream TIMEOUT errors when proxy calls model backend: "context deadline exceeded" and a couple of "kv-cache miss" lines. Posting tail of proxy logs:
```
2026-03-17T22:14:01Z proxy: upstream call timeout to model-backend-12 (deadline exceeded)
2026-03-17T22:14:03Z proxy: 502 returned to client for request id=... upstream_err=502
```
opsbot: Incident created -> INC-2026-428, severity=P1. Incident channel: #inc-2026-428-bridge.
alice: I'm going to pause rollout and pull canary to 0% while we triage. Recommend hitting feature flag: prompt-edge.canary=false (hotstop).
sara: Agreed. Oncall will flip. Tagging @matt to validate logs post-flip.
sara: Executing kill-switch now — running redwood-ff toggle prompt-edge.canary off --scope canary --author=sara
deploy-bot: Feature flag update applied: prompt-edge.canary=false for canary slices. Propagation complete (5s).
sara: Confirming: all canary traffic diverted to stable route. Please monitor error rate.
matt: Error rate dropping — from 4.6% -> 1.2% in last 90s. p95 latency trending down.
csm-raj: CS on bridge with AcmeCorp — they're reporting responses returned after a retry; minimal data loss. Keeping them updated.
alice: Opening a quick customer-impact note: affected customers seen ~30-120s degraded responses during rollout window. No data exfiltration.
ben: Adding that we saw a short burst of backend connection saturation on model-backend-12 at 22:13:50. Might be resource contention with new kernel build.
matt: We should avoid immediate rollforward of v3. We'll hold the release and investigate model-backend health and kernel selection paths.
sara: Handoff to infra team for deeper root cause. @ben / @matt taking incident lead after me. I'll update pager and go back on standby.
incident-bot: Pager duty note updated: oncall handover -> new lead: matt, secondary: ben. Incident status: mitigated (customer impact reduced), investigating (RC).
matt: Creating follow-up tasks: 1) rollback candidate validation, 2) kernel selection stress test, 3) add guardrail to canary (cpu/conn thresholds).
csm-raj: CS will follow up with the two impacted customers with timeline and mitigation summary.
alice: Filing postmortem draft and CCing product + runtime teams. Will include metrics and exact flag timeline.
sara: Closing immediate bridge. If spike returns, we will re-open and consider full FF off (global). :white_check_mark:
ben: Noted. I'll start repro runs against model-backend-12 and check kernel release notes.
matt: Thanks all. Final check: error rate back to baseline and customer-facing issues reduced. Moving to post-incident review.
sara: Handing off monitor to matt. Oncall out. :wave:
